messages.content: Hello, this MPRN (3966436508) has an incorrect transfer read on (30 Aug 2025). We believe it should be (15452) and have the following back reads: (18 Jan 2025 – 15008) and (29 Feb 2024 – 14336). However, since CoS date is older than a year ago, we cannot raise a SARs. Would you be able to verbally agree the new CoS read?
